subject: Lindra expansion: staged onboarding, capacity addendum & term timing
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@lindra.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Lindra expansion: staged onboarding, capacity addendum & term timing

Hi Sara —

Great to hear Lindra is ready to onboard two more product teams. Summary of what we discussed on the call:

- Add 3 additional projects/apps (ClinicalBot, IntakeForm, ClaimsScrub)
- Each project will receive a dedicated API key and segmented usage bucket for governance
- Staged rollout over 6 weeks (pilot -> team A -> team B) to limit token spike risk
- You asked about a short-term capacity buffer and a one-off amendment to extend the committed units for Q2

Attached is a first-pass staged rollout spreadsheet and a draft amendment that outlines the capacity bump and term alignment. Can you confirm:

1) The start date for pilot (you mentioned early March)
2) If Procurement wants the amendment or a standalone PO
3) Any new compliance artifacts we should pre-share for the IntakeForm integration

If that all looks right, I’ll loop Monica (CS) to finalize the operational steps and Ben to confirm commercial terms.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: staged-rollout-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), Lindra_Amendment_v1.pdf (draft amendment)
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@lindra.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lindra.com>
Date: 2026-02-14T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Lindra expansion: staged onboarding, capacity addendum & term timing

Thanks Connor — this looks good. Quick answers:  

1) Pilot start: target week of 2026-03-09 (team has a development freeze the prior week)
2) Procurement will need an amendment and a PO; they prefer a single-line PO referencing the amendment and SOW
3) For IntakeForm we need the data flow diagram and the data retention commitment (30 days) to attach to our change request

Looping in Procurement so they can confirm PO cadence and questions on the amendment. Also looping in our engineering lead (cc'd separately) to triage the DFD request.

Sara
Senior Product Manager, Lindra Health Systems
sara.lin@lindra.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@lindra.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T10:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Lindra expansion: staged onboarding, capacity addendum & term timing

Hi Sara — excited to get this moving. Operational notes and ask:  

- Pilot scope: ClinicalBot only, up to 5 internal users, 2k requests/day target
- Keys: we will provision three API keys (pilot, team-a, team-b). Keys are environment-tagged and can be rotated independently.
- Rollout checkpoints (week-by-week):
  * Week 0 (provision): API keys, initial rate limits, and dedicated telemetry dashboard
  * Week 1-2 (pilot): integration support, latency baseline verification, and prefix caching enabled
  * Week 3-4 (team A): expand rate limits, begin canary traffic split
  * Week 5-6 (team B): full production traffic and finalize alerts/SLOs
- Data retention: we can confirm a 30-day ephemeral KV/cache retention policy for IntakeForm flows; I’ll attach the DFD and retention language as a short CSV for Procurement to file.

Please confirm the three project short names/owners so security & SRE can pre-approve network rules. Also confirm if you want per-project cost centers set up in billing.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachment: SOW_Lindra_ProjectList.csv (project short names and owners)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@lindra.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Sara Lin <sara.lin@lindra.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-17T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Lindra expansion: staged onboarding, capacity addendum & term timing

Hi all — commercial details below to make the PO straightforward:  

- Proposed Q2 committed units (one-off addendum): 12M tokens additional, billed across March–May as a usage buffer.
- Unit price: $0.90 per 1k tokens for additional committed units (same tier as your current volume pricing).
- Base contract term: keep existing end date (2026-12-31). Amendment will only add committed units and a small short-term capacity surcharge (one-time $2,500 activation fee).
- If Lindra prefers, we can spread committed units across the three projects with separate sub-lines; that will make internal chargeback easier.

Connor will send a DocuSign-ready amendment PDF when you confirm the numbers; procurement, if you confirm monthly billing with 30-day terms, we’ll mark that in the amendment.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Procurement Team <procurement@lindra.com>

Ben/Connor —

Confirmed: procurement will approve a single-line PO referencing the amendment with the following fields populated: total committed units (12,000,000), unit price ($0.90/1k), activation fee ($2,500), billing contact (finance@lindra.com), and invoice cadence (monthly, NET30). Please route the DocuSign envelope to procurement@lindra.com and finance@lindra.com once ready.

We will aim to have the PO back within 5 business days after signature.

Procurement Team
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@lindra.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@lindra.com>

Date: 2026-02-19T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Lindra expansion: staged onboarding, capacity addendum & term timing

Thanks everyone — next steps summarized below:  

- I will upload the DocuSign-ready amendment (Lindra_Amendment_v1.pdf) and send the envelope to procurement@lindra.com by EOD 2026-02-19.
- Monica will provision the three API keys and create the staged rollout board; pilot start targeted 2026-03-09.
- Aditya will prepare the short DFD and retention language for IntakeForm and post to the shared Drive folder (link above).
- Procurement: please return the signed PO within 5 business days after signature; we’ll queue activation once DocuSign clears.

If anything changes, flag here — otherwise we’ll proceed with the plan.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Connor
